Name: Starlight Celebration
Author: 13midnight
Description:
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/TMLbX1Qz/Mod-Cover-Make1r.png[/img][/center]
[size=4]
The people in Pelican Town have a tradition when the year begins.[/size]
[size=3]Wishing for good blessings by sending tokens in sky lanterns![/size]

[size=2]The Ferngill Department of Culture is trying its best to bring back this tradition to the valley.[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/khSpT4Y/compatibility.png[/img]

List of compatibilities~
[spoiler]
[size=2]---- Recolours ----[/size]
Uses vanilla tilesheets to make the map, so it should be recolour friendly :3

[size=2]---- Festival Adding Mods ----[/size]
Should not interfere with them ^^

[size=2]---- SVE ----[/size]
Yes, it should work with SVE.
Idk about SVE lore so I won't be adding specific dialogue regarding to it.[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/3vBx7vz/configuration.png[/img]
Make sure to use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] so you can check your configs easier~
Read carefully!

[spoiler]
[size=2]---- Buff Modification ----[/size]
[b]Luck:[/b] Change the luck buff provided by Lucky Meal buff.
(Default is 4)
[b]Fishing: [/b]Change the defense and attack buffs provided by Jade Fish buff.
(Default is 5)[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JzvFMLL/what-is-added.png[/img]
[size=2][color=#ff0000]Spoilers for the mod ahead, continue with precaution.[/color][/size]
[spoiler]
[size=2]---- Starlight Celebration Festival ----[/size]
A new festival that happens on Spring 2 from Year 2 onwards.
It takes place in a version of the summit (so you must head to the railroad for the festival).

You can have the chance to talk to some mysterious kitties (If you know Mirin then they may look familiar!)
Who can offer you a choice for a token blessing.
(One particular blessing is only available if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23135]Cloudy Skies[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22612]More Nightly Events[/url])
[spoiler]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/8DyV5rLS/20250712213820-1.jpg[/img][/spoiler]

Or if you want to donate some money!
(Some higher donations may lead to some villagers noticing and loving your contributions!)
(Higher donations unlock upon your money availability the day of the festival!)
[spoiler]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/YFYyH82k/20250712213813-1.jpg[/img][/spoiler]

[color=#ff0000][size=2]BUT BEWARE![/size][/color]
You can only talk to the kitties once!
So make sure you are certain about your choices.
(This is due to limitations for Festivals, I cannot fix yet...)


[size=2]---- Starlight Celebration Shop ----[/size]
Pierre has some goods for sale!
If you get a Joja Membership, Pierre is a little upset and will double the prices...
[u]Foods:
[/u]
[spoiler]
[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/gL75NB9b/Objects-Copy.png[/img] Fortune Cake[/b]
95% chance to get a luck buff upon eating!
[img]https://i.ibb.co/qY9RKYWq/Buffs.png[/img] Buff duration is all-day and the luck is configurable.
Sold for 10,000g.
Only 1 available.

[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/6RM75fnP/Objects-Copy-2.png[/img] Golden Truffle[/b]
95% chance to find some money upon eating!
Quantity can range from 5 (very common) to 50000!
Sold for 10,000g.
Only 1 available.[/spoiler]

[u]Furniture:
[/u]
[spoiler]
[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/C519GJfV/Lanterns-Copy.png[/img] Red Lantern[/b]
Works like a lamp!
Sold for 10,000g.
Only 1 available.

[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/1GJsHLj1/Lanterns.png[/img] Box Lantern[/b]
Works like a lamp!
Sold for 10,000g.
Only 1 available.

[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/0ywFJgY7/Lanterns-Copy-2.png[/img] Tall Lantern[/b]
Works like a lamp!
Sold for 10,000g.
Only 1 available.

[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/Z6rQMmB1/Lanterns2.png[/img] Lilypad Lantern[/b]
Works like a machine with light!
Must be placed in water.
Sold for 10,000g.
Only 1 available.
Only available if [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975]Machine Terrain Framework[/url] is present.[/spoiler]

[u]Other goods:[/u]
There is a 25% chance that one of these may be available, and a 10% chance that another one of these may be available!
Only 1 would be available per chance.
[spoiler]
[b]Small Glow Ring[/b]
(20% chances)
[b]Glow Ring[/b]
(20% chances)
[b]Green Tea[/b]
(50% chances)
[b]Lucky Ring[/b]
(10% chances)

Any for 2,500g![/spoiler]

[size=2]---- Starlight Celebration Blessings ----[/size]
These can be chosen (only 1 and you only have one chance during the dialogue!) before you talk to Lewis.
After you talk to Lewis and send your lantern up in the sky, maybe you can be blessed!
[spoiler]
[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/Xx12k7kp/Tokens.png[/img] Golden Token[/b]
[u]Possible Blessings:[/u]
Money can be earned (Up to 1000 any given time).
Qi Coins can be earned (Up to 50 any given time).
(Qi Coins from this blessing can only be earned once 100 golden walnuts are found)
[u]
Duration:[/u]
Blessing possibility will disappear on the 14th of Spring.

[u]Chance:[/u]
25% every day.

[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/KcKwPbV8/Tokens-Copy.png[/img] Ink Stone[/b]
[u]Possible Blessings:[/u]
Skill books can be earned (Up to 1).
Food item can be earned (Up to 1).
(Relatively common food items...)
[u]
Duration:[/u]
Blessing possibility will disappear on the 14th of Spring.

[u]Chance:[/u]
5% every day for skill books.
10% every day for food.


[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/9mZJW9vb/Tokens-Copy-2.png[/img] Sunset Orange[/b]
[u]Possible Blessings:[/u]
Giant Crops to grow in farm and appear in the backwoods.
Crops to grow in farm and appear in farm.
(Up to 5 giant crops, and up to 10 crops enhanced)
[u]
Duration:[/u]
Blessing possibility will disappear on the 28th of Spring.

[u]Chance:[/u]
10% every night.
100% if fates allow.
(If the random day is equal to the day for condition)

[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/Q3bsDsZF/Tokens-Copy-3.png[/img] Crystal Tear[/b]
[u]Possible Blessings:[/u]
Summon rain in the valley for tomorrow.
Summon storm in the valley for tomorrow.
[u]
Duration:[/u]
Blessing possibility will disappear on the 28th of Spring.

[u]Chance:[/u]
20% every day for rain.
10% every day for storm.


[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/yBW2041b/Tokens-Copy-4.png[/img] Red Knot[/b]
[u]Possible Blessings:[/u]
Stone chest in farm with some goods, and some Basic Retaining Soil on hoed dirt.
Chest in farm with some goods, and some Speed-Gro on hoed dirt.
(Up to 10 hoed dirt spots enhanced)
[spoiler]

Up to 5

[b]Red Firework[/b]

Up to 2

[b]Fairy Dust[/b]
75% Chance

[u]
Duration:[/u]
Blessing possibility will disappear on the 28th of Spring.

[u]Chance:[/u]
10% every night.
100% if fates allow.
(If the random day is equal to the day for condition)

[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/jkpPgMts/Tokens-Copy-5.png[/img] Jade Fish[/b]
[u]Possible Blessings:[/u]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Wv0Y0RdF/Buffs-Copy.png[/img] Fishing buff that can be configurable.
[u]
Duration:[/u]
Blessing possibility will disappear on the 8th of Spring.

[u]Chance:[/u]
25% every day.

[b]Leaving it up to fate - Random!
[/b]Enables any of the above to also occur with different chances.
[spoiler]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Xx12k7kp/Tokens.png[/img] [b]Golden Token[/b]
10% chance
